listing.name: Super Mario Galaxy (Galaxy Android)
listing.summary: An Android ARM64 Super Mario Galaxy port derived from decompilation work. Vulkan 1.0 and AAudio are required. The project’s features and planned higher frame rates/camera improvements remain its own claims or plans; complete campaign and device coverage are unconfirmed. Petari ancestry does not establish desktop support. Use your own Wii disc with the project’s extraction/conversion instructions. Exact accepted revision/hashes and BIOS/firmware needs are unconfirmed. You and the project manage setup and updates; Portcove has not qualified a release package or confirmed setup or gameplay.
